capabilities: Render colour marks, tags, scratch cards, phonetic annotations and progress bars inline
Split quote blocks and lists into equal-height columns and combine tables, images and code into tab groups
Merge table cells, fold row groups, and auto-number captions for tables, figures, code and formulas
Export notes as a self-contained HTML file or publish as PDF
Switch between built-in and downloadable colour themes with light/dark transitions
extras: Only the default Ignorance theme is bundled; additional themes download from the plugin's GitHub releases on first use or can be dropped into the themes folder manually. ZenUML diagrams and online fonts are opt-in network features under Settings. Mobile devices export HTML for system printing instead of generating PDF directly.
intentEvidence: It is a re-implementation for Obsidian, inspired by VLOOK for Typora and published with the original author's permission
problem: Obsidian's default Markdown rendering lacks rich document typesetting such as coloured marks, multi-level tags, quote-block columns, merged table cells, covers, and polished one-click HTML or PDF export.

relations.evidence: 语法与整体设计参考 MadMaxChow/VLOOK（VLOOK for Typora），感谢原作者 Max Chow 的授权与支持

summary: Typesetting engine that renders VLOOK syntax for colour marks, tags, columns, merged tables and tab groups, and exports single-file HTML or PDF.
